exposure: composition of breast milk (macronutrients, epidermal growth factor - EGF)
lactating mother's diet (oil intake, soybean and soybean product intake)
cohort: A total of 94 42-day postpartum mother-infant pairs in Beijing were enrolled to investigate late-onset breast milk jaundice.
finding: Epidermal growth factor (EGF) concentration in breast milk was lower in the BMJ group, and EGF may inhibit late-onset BMJ, with maternal dietary oil intake potentially being a protective factor by increasing EGF levels in breast milk.
